classes.description: Full-width docked panel (--sidebar-width, 16rem). Docks into the start column of a scaffold.
Minimized panel (--sidebar-rail-width, 4rem). Fades .nav-labels and keeps item icons centred.
Docks the sidebar into the end column of a scaffold instead of the start.
Variant that applies a utility to descendants only while the sidebar is a rail, e.g. sidebar-rail:hidden.
